description.p: This is a community package of Metrolist, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the Metrolist project. It repackages the official upstream Linux AppImage unmodified.
Metrolist is a YouTube Music client with a Material Design interface, built with Kotlin and Compose Multiplatform.

ul.li: Browse, search and play YouTube Music, with or without signing in.
Sign in to use your library, playlists and listening history.
Synced lyrics, an equalizer and background playback.
Media controls (MPRIS) and a tray icon.

description.p: Permissions: this package grants display (X11), GPU, audio, network access, the desktop keyring, and your Downloads and Music folders. Settings, the sign-in session and caches stay inside the sandbox under ~/.var/app/com.metrolist.desktop.

ul.li: Interface too small or too large on a HiDPI screen (Metrolist detects the scale with desktop tools such as hyprctl or gsettings, which can't see your desktop's settings from inside the sandbox): set the scale yourself, for example flatpak override --user --env=METROLIST_FORCE_SCALE=2 com.metrolist.desktop. Undo it with flatpak override --user --unset-env=METROLIST_FORCE_SCALE com.metrolist.desktop.
